verdict.rationale: Chargebee docs explicitly describe an API Explorer that lets users make live API calls in a browser via a guided interface to test endpoints without writing code (chargebee-docs-9), directly matching the interactive/runnable-example story; getting-started docs also cover auth and request format context (chargebee-docs-1, chargebee-docs-17). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the explorer's usability, and no OpenAPI spec was found (chargebee-probe-3), which would strengthen a fully agentic/machine-readable reference.
